faqs.question: When did Karunya’s agriculture school begin?
faqs.answer: The school’s official page states 2017; that is the school date, not the university’s founding year.

faqs.question: Which agricultural programmes are listed?
faqs.answer: The current school page names B.Sc. Agriculture and master’s courses in agronomy, genetics and plant breeding, and fruit sciences.

faqs.question: Are protected-cultivation facilities documented?
faqs.answer: Yes. The school names polyhouses and mist chambers alongside research plots.

faqs.question: Does the checked ICAR entry accredit Karunya’s master’s programmes?
faqs.answer: The audited row prints only B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture. A broader website claim is unresolved and is not adopted here.

faqs.question: Is PCM alone definitely accepted?
faqs.answer: The academics page includes PCM, while the located brochure uses different biology/agriculture wording. Confirm the current intake rule directly.

faqs.question: Which agriculture or allied programmes are covered at KITS?
faqs.answer: This profile covers B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture; M.Sc. (Agriculture) Agronomy; M.Sc. (Agriculture) Genetics and Plant Breeding; M.Sc. (Horticulture) Fruit Sciences. The [courses and fees table](/university/karunya-institute-of-technology-and-sciences/course-fee) separates the qualifications and published fee periods.

faqs.question: How long is B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at KITS?
faqs.answer: 4 years. The school describes crop, soil and plant-health study linked with field practice.

faqs.question: How long is M.Sc. (Agriculture) Agronomy at KITS?
faqs.answer: 2 years. Postgraduate study includes field projects, laboratory analysis and research documentation.

faqs.question: How long is M.Sc. (Agriculture) Genetics and Plant Breeding at KITS?
faqs.answer: 2 years. A specialist crop-improvement degree in the current school programme list.

faqs.question: How long is M.Sc. (Horticulture) Fruit Sciences at KITS?
faqs.answer: 2 years. The school lists a separate fruit-crop postgraduate programme.

faqs.question: What are the entry requirements for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at KITS?
faqs.answer: The 2027 UG admissions page states a minimum 60% qualifying-examination requirement for confirmation. Confirm the programme-specific subjects for that intake; older academic pages and brochures list different combinations and thresholds.

faqs.question: What are the entry requirements for M.Sc. (Agriculture) Agronomy at KITS?
faqs.answer: 2023 brochure: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture with minimum OGPA 6.00/10; reconfirm for intended intake.

faqs.question: What are the entry requirements for M.Sc. (Agriculture) Genetics and Plant Breeding at KITS?
faqs.answer: The exact intake-year subject and marks rule still needs confirmation through [the official admission route](/university/karunya-institute-of-technology-and-sciences/admission-process).

faqs.question: What are the entry requirements for M.Sc. (Horticulture) Fruit Sciences at KITS?
faqs.answer: The exact intake-year subject and marks rule still needs confirmation through [the official admission route](/university/karunya-institute-of-technology-and-sciences/admission-process).

faqs.question: What fee is documented for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at KITS?
faqs.answer: ₹1,46,750 / semester · 2026-27. Tuition for each of eight semesters in the 2026-30 cohort fee sheet; one-time admission fee INR 10,000; examination fees extra. Included charges: Published tuition/course fee; additional charges must be checked separately.

faqs.question: What fee is documented for M.Sc. (Agriculture) Agronomy at KITS?
faqs.answer: ₹60,750 / semester · 2026-27. Each of four semesters costs INR 60,750 tuition. One-time admission INR 5,000 is separate. The schedule explicitly names Agronomy, Genetics and Plant Breeding, and Fruit Science; this is not an NRI tariff. Included charges: Tuition for the 2026–28 Indian-national cohort; exam, professional-development and placement-training charges excluded.

faqs.question: What fee is documented for M.Sc. (Agriculture) Genetics and Plant Breeding at KITS?
faqs.answer: ₹60,750 / semester · 2026-27. Each of four semesters costs INR 60,750 tuition. One-time admission INR 5,000 is separate. The schedule explicitly names Agronomy, Genetics and Plant Breeding, and Fruit Science; this is not an NRI tariff. Included charges: Tuition for the 2026–28 Indian-national cohort; exam, professional-development and placement-training charges excluded.

faqs.question: What fee is documented for M.Sc. (Horticulture) Fruit Sciences at KITS?
faqs.answer: ₹60,750 / semester · 2026-27. Each of four semesters costs INR 60,750 tuition. One-time admission INR 5,000 is separate. The schedule explicitly names Agronomy, Genetics and Plant Breeding, and Fruit Science; this is not an NRI tariff. Included charges: Tuition for the 2026–28 Indian-national cohort; exam, professional-development and placement-training charges excluded.

faqs.question: How does admission to KITS work?
faqs.answer: The live official UG admissions page now describes the 2027 cycle. It states that KEE 2027 is mandatory for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture and that confirmation depends on the stated qualifying-examination requirements. Treat these as next-cycle instructions; the 2026–30 cohort fee sheet below remains explicitly labelled by its own source session. Older academic and brochure descriptions differ, so request the exact intake-year subject rules. Confirm the course: Use the official programme contact to confirm that the listed degree is taking applications for your intended intake. Request the intake notice: Ask for the applicable selection rules, fee breakdown and document checklist before submitting an application.

faqs.question: What is the recorded ICAR scope for KITS?
faqs.answer: Karunya Institute of Technology and Sciences (Deemed University), Coimbatore: B. Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture (Intake-180), recorded term 2022-10-11 to 2027-10-10. This entry applies to the named unit and programme.

faqs.question: What practical learning is described at KITS?
faqs.answer: The school describes instructional and research farmland, polyhouses, mist chambers and research plots. Its brochure additionally identifies experiential-learning modules, an agrometeorological observatory and an automatic weather station.

faqs.question: Which teaching facilities are documented at KITS?
faqs.answer: Protected cultivation structures: Polyhouses and mist chambers are named in the school’s facilities account. Agrometeorological facilities: The brochure identifies an observatory and automatic weather station.

faqs.question: What student facilities are documented for KITS?
faqs.answer: The school describes instructional and research farmland, polyhouses, mist chambers and research plots. Its brochure additionally identifies experiential-learning modules, an agrometeorological observatory and an automatic weather station. Accommodation availability, meal charges and transport arrangements for your entry year still need direct confirmation.

faqs.question: What scholarship information is available for KITS?
faqs.answer: Karunya’s 2026–27 scholarship page explicitly includes B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture in its Indian-student merit grid. The separate Founder’s Scholarship offers a limited 100% tuition waiver for eligible Indian Christian applicants; its 2026 application and selection dates have passed. B.Sc. Agriculture Indian-student merit grid, 2026–27: The agriculture column lists INR 1,20,000 at 95% PCM/PCB, INR 60,000 at 90%, and INR 40,000 at 85%. These are scholarship amounts, not net tuition payable. Obtain the approved award and applicable continuation terms. Founder’s Scholarship 2026–27: Limited 100% tuition waiver for selected Indian Christian applicants with at least 90% PCM/PCB and annual family income below INR 8 lakh. Screening includes documentary verification and interview. The 29 May 2026 deadline is past.

faqs.question: What training and outcome evidence is available for KITS?
faqs.answer: Karunya Institute of Technology and Sciences publishes an Agriculture and Allied Sectors submission for NIRF 2026. Its programme-duration cohorts report the graduating group, students placed, students entering higher studies and the median salary of placed graduates. These historical institutional submissions are not a placement promise or a salary estimate for every student or individual specialisation.

faqs.question: How can I contact KITS about an application?
faqs.answer: Published phone: 1800 425 4300. Published email: admissions@karunya.edu. Official admissions: https://admissions.karunya.edu/campaign/admissions/

faqs.question: Which dated admission notices are recorded for KITS?
faqs.answer: Founder scholarship application deadline (past; scholarship scope, not general admissions) · 2026-05-29 · 2026-27. These are the dates of the named events; an earlier deadline does not establish a current opening.
